basic_info.description: Unlock the potential of this charming detached single-family home on a quiet street in one of San Francisco's most established neighborhoods. Situated on a single level, the home features a long driveway that fits two cars, plus a detached one-car garage, ideal for additional parking, storage, or future creative use. Inside, you'll find two well-sized bedrooms with generous closets and one full bathroom. Original hardwood floors run throughout the home, ready to be revived. A covered front patio sets a welcoming tone, while the spacious living room features a wood-burning fireplace flanked by two bright windows. The formal dining room is perfect for hosting, and the original kitchen opens directly to the backyard, a seamless setup for outdoor entertaining or expansion potential.  The floor plan offers smart separation between bedrooms, with one in the front and one in the back, divided by the bathroom for added privacy. A small rear deck wraps around the home, leading to a detached garage with bonus storage and workspace.  Walk to local shops, restaurants along Mission Street, and explore nearby John McLaren Park just one block away. Commuters will love the quick access to the 101 freeway, only 15 minutes to both Downtown SF and SFO, and a 20-minute walk to Balboa Park BART.
